map.Luhn：由右至左偶位 × 2（> 9 减 9）后求和，总和 mod 10 =: Luhn: from right to left, even-position digits × 2 (subtract 9 if > 9), sum all; total mod 10 = 0
map.依据 Luhn 算法（IBM 科学家 Hans Peter Luhn 于 195: Validate the card number by the Luhn algorithm (proposed by IBM scientist Hans Peter Luhn in 1954); the same method is also used for IMEI and Canadian SIN, etc.; format check only, no account verification.
map.Luhn 算法（又称\"模 10\"算法）由 IBM 科学家 Hans Pete: The Luhn algorithm (also called the 'mod 10' algorithm) was proposed by IBM scientist Hans Peter Luhn in 1954, used to validate credit card numbers, IMEI, Canadian Social Insurance Numbers, etc.
map.1. 从右往左，将偶数位（第 2、4、6…位）的数字乘以 2；: 1. From right to left, multiply the even-position digits (2nd, 4th, 6th...) by 2;
map.2. 若乘积为两位数，将两位数相加（或减 9）；: 2. If the product is two digits, add the two digits (or subtract 9);
map.4. 若总和能被 10 整除，则校验通过。: 4. If the total is divisible by 10, validation passes.

map.能检出所有单数字错误和约 90% 的相邻数字换位错误；但无法识别故意构造的合规假: It detects all single-digit errors and about 90% of adjacent transpositions; but cannot recognize deliberately constructed compliant fake numbers.
map.通过 Luhn 就是有效卡号吗？: Does passing Luhn mean a valid card number?
map.不是。Luhn 只验证校验位，卡号是否真实、可否授权须由发卡行与支付网关确认。: No. Luhn only verifies the check digit; whether the card is real or can be authorized must be confirmed by the issuer and payment gateway.
map.不会。卡号只在浏览器本地计算，不上传、不存储。: No. The card number is computed only locally in the browser; not uploaded, not stored.
